subject: The AI tool writing follow-ups so you don't have to
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most studio owners lose leads simply because they don't reply fast enough — not because the lead wasn't interested. 78% of buyers go with whoever responds first.


One AI tool changes that: it writes and sends every follow-up message automatically, tailored to each lead's stage. New inquiry? It drafts a friendly intro text within seconds. No response after 24 hours? It sends a natural nudge — not a generic “just checking in.” Booked but didn't show? It follows up with a tailored re-engagement message. You never write a follow-up by hand again, and every lead gets touched consistently instead of falling through the cracks.
